auto_approve.finding: Even after a target PR and WEC check, pending-run listing/approval is not filtered to the resolved HEAD SHA. Both batch and nonbatch paths can approve repository-wide action_required runs.
auto_approve.decision: Do not recommend blanket approval; approval would delegate further approvals, not merely run a passive test. Human CI owner must review exact scope and guards first.

semgrep.finding: SAST/SARIF workflow, not a full-suite test or coverage gate.
semgrep.decision: Human approval must review the exact run SHA and permissions separately; no blanket safety clearance asserted.

rust_swarm.finding: Runs cargo tarpaulin and tests/rust_integration/. No pinned be91ba82 checkout or full Python tests/ coverage command with an 80% gate is present in these jobs. fail_ci_if_error:false is a Codecov upload setting, not a coverage threshold.
rust_swarm.decision: Approving this run does not establish the requested pinned full-suite 80% result.

publication.reason: Only assigned-branch publication is available in this session; alternate branch writes are not permitted, and the recovery branch must retain workflows identical to base. No shell push or credential workaround attempted.

publication.full_suite_future_requirement: An explicitly authorized clean CI job must pin the intended snapshot, provision the recorded dependency environment, run the complete suite without weakened selection, preserve all exits/JUnit/coverage and enforce 80%.
